title: OSWorld1
domain: Open-ended tasks on a real Ubuntu desktop and its applications, each in a VM of its own.
good_to_know: Original runs one of OSWorld's own agents, chosen by the Agent option (M3 by default), with a model it is published with.
Each agent needs the provider that serves its model: OpenAI for OpenAI CUA, your own model server for EvoCUA, both AutoGLM-OS agents, Mano and Muse Spark, and OpenRouter for the other six.
Only M3, PromptAgent and Qwen-CUA have been run on tasks here. The other agents were checked up to their first model call.
Each task runs in a VM of its own with 4 CPU cores and 4 GB of memory. Run only as many tasks at once as the machine holds.
Prepare the machine before the first run (Docker, KVM, five system libraries, a VM image of about 25 GB): see the OSWorld1 machine setup page.
Scores depend on the machine's speed, because OSWorld waits a fixed time after each action. Compare runs made on similar machines.
upstream_limitations: OSWorld publishes no solutions: no reference run shows that each task can be solved.
The 8 Google Drive tasks need a Google account's credentials, which OSWorld does not ship. They are in All tasks only.

49 tasks ask for a proxy whose credentials OSWorld does not ship. PromptAgent, GPT-5.4, OpenAI CUA, OS-Symphony, EvoCUA and Muse Spark always use it: for them those tasks fail or run without a network.
The VM image is not pinned: a later download can differ from the one a score was made with.

OSWorld's docker provider opens each VM's ports on every network interface of the machine, including a port that runs any command in the VM. Bind Docker's ports to 127.0.0.1, or keep the machine off untrusted networks.
limitations: No agent from the Agents page can run it yet.
OSWorld's other agents are not offered: at this commit they fail before their first model call, or call services that Nullius's relay cannot reach.
Only OSWorld's docker VM provider is offered, and only on Docker's default socket: rootless Docker and Docker contexts are not reached. Podman is untested.
The Windows tasks are not offered.
A task still running after 2 hours is stopped and gets no score.

datasets.title: OSWorld, Ubuntu tasks
datasets.verifier: OSWorld's own evaluator, DesktopEnv.evaluate: the task's evaluator functions on the VM's final state.
datasets.notes: 369 tasks in 10 domains; 361 without Google Drive. Apache-2.0.
